title: Halo CE enemies (standalone version)
load: HaloCE_Standalone_Bundle.pk3 on its own, with any other mods.   Flood / Sentinels / Marines: HaloCE_Standalone_Core.pk3 -> faction packs, or HaloCE_Standalone_Merged.pk3 for everything. Never load the bundle together with HaloCE_Standalone_Core.

bundle_folder.name: HaloCE_Standalone_Bundle
header: // Halo CE enemies, standalone bundle: Covenant (Grunts, Jackals, Elites, Hunters), the Digsite add-on (Drinol +
